longDescription:
Media Control for D200 brings current-media information and controls from a Mac to the Ulanzi D200.

Media display
• Show artwork, title, artist, playback state, and progress.
• Combine four artwork tiles into a live 2x2 mosaic.
• Use the large center display for artwork and playback details.

Controls and customization
• Control Previous, Play/Pause, Next, macOS output volume, and mute.
• Choose independent control-icon and artwork-tile badge colors.
• Choose the Now Playing accent used by the playback badge and filled progress bar.
• Assign an optional media or system-audio action to each artwork tile.

Local operation
Ulanzi Studio starts the bundled D200 bridge when needed. The plugin and bridge run on the same Mac, communicate only through an authenticated loopback connection, and require no cloud service or account. Current-media data uses Apple's private MediaRemote framework.

Validation scope
The v2.4.0 badge and accent customization was manually confirmed on the user's local setup. A local v2.1.0 package was also validated with Ulanzi Studio and a physical D200 on the tested setup. Signing, notarization, marketplace publication or acceptance, and compatibility across other macOS, Studio, or device versions remain unproven.
